# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Return of the Exiles to Jerusalem

---

**11:1** Sound in Zion the trumpet of the sanctuary!
Proclaim in Jerusalem the voice of the herald of good news!

**11:2** For God has shown mercy to Israel
by visiting them again.

**11:3** Stand on a high place, O Jerusalem, and look upon your children,
who are being gathered from east to west by the LORD.

**11:4** From the north they come, gathered by God;
from the distant islands God has gathered them.

**11:5** He has leveled great mountains to a plain for them;
the hills have fled before their approach.

**11:6** The forests provided them shade as they passed;
God made every fragrant tree to grow for them,

**11:7** that Israel might walk in the glory of God.
Put on your robes of glory, O Jerusalem, your holy garments;

**11:8** clothe yourself in your holy vestments, O Jerusalem,
for God has declared good things for Israel forever and ever.

**11:9** May the LORD perform what he has promised for Israel and Jerusalem;
may the LORD exalt Israel by his glorious name.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal English rendering following Greek syntax. Poetic lineation preserved. Archaic forms avoided.*
